peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 0.5% above its local comparables; 77 of 144 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (83.0): 4.7 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 332 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 8). Initial resale-wave effect: 3 of the 6 resales in Oct 2024–Sep 2026 came in the first 12 months of the resale wave (Oct 2024–Jul 2025); the sustained rate is shown separately. The wave start is based on the analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date. Context, not scored: resales in 25% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,235,000 ($2,325 psf, 527–538 sq ft; 6 resales, May 2024–Apr 2026); 7 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,313 psf (range $1,697–2,763); 0.5% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $6,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: 4 resales per 100 homes a year over 14 months (Aug 2025–Sep 2026): higher than 279 of 388 similar developments. First resale wave from Aug 2024 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date); 1 earlier resale does not start the wave. Observed 24-month activity: 4.7.

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Dhoby Ghaut MRT about 290 m, Bencoolen MRT about 360 m; closer than 423 of 551 similar developments (the same as 8). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest ST. Margaret's School (Primary) about 390 m; more than 107 of 551 similar developments (the same as 202). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 5 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 330 m), more than 170 of 551 similar developments (the same as 41); nearest hawker centre Tekka Centre/Zhu Jiao Market about 640 m; nearest park Mount Emily Park about 270 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (The Collective at One Sophia, 16 new sales, about 130 m; Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 290 m; Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 400 m; Midtown Modern, 1 new sales, about 1,050 m; Canninghill Piers, 8 new sales, about 1,110 m; Hill House, 5 new sales, about 1,120 m; Midtown Bay, 4 new sales, about 1,170 m; Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 1,180 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 335 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,454 new sales and 1,128 resales (2,582 purchases); new sales were 56.3% of these purchases. Subsales (64) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,128 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 372 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,128 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,198 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−5.8%). Planning-area private resales −9.4%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
